extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers interested in comparative mythology and Vedic religion
extracted.subtask_description: A descriptive chapter summarizing major Vedic deities (Indra, Agni, Varuna, Mitra, Surya, Ushas, Soma, etc.), their myths, attributes, worship practices, and parallels with other Indo-European traditions. Useful as a reference or introductory survey in comparative religion/mythology.
